set.body: Implement the public Scala 3 Grid -> Task -> Batch -> ExecutionPlan -> BatchHandle model for parameter sweeps. Preserve independent, sharded, and gang semantics as distinct typed plans. Materialize script arguments before transport; never serialize closures or shell command strings. Add pure plan validation and deterministic assignment, remote registered-task batch submission, target-side array and gang lowering, per-element durable result handles, documentation, and focused tests. Routine planning and submission failures remain typed data. Acceptance: 3x3x3 grid is deterministic; independent lowers to 27 array elements; 9x3 sharded and 3 shards x 9 rows with five slots validate and lower correctly; gang requests 9 nodes and 3 ranks per node; remote loopback preserves all 27 inputs/results; no production casts, partial constructors, or stringly command payloads.
